Marvel's Spidey and his Amazing Friends tells the story of Peter Parker, Miles Morales and Gwen Stacy, who together form Team Spidey and embark on heroic adventures to protect their community. Geared towards preschoolers and their families, the series models the importance of teamwork and helping others and highlights themes of friendship, cooperation and problem-solving.

recentItems.title: BeddyByes Clips Compilation! ❤️☁️ | 30 Minutes | Bedtime Stories for Winding Down | Disney Jr.
recentItems.description:
Watch this BeddyByes clips compilation! Join best friends MeMo and BaBa as they travel across the remarkable Planet BeddyByes, meeting new and familiar faces on their mindful and soothing journey to bedtime.

Featured clips:
00:00 Dance
MeMo and BaBa learn that everyone can dance and all dancing is different.

01:42 Seeds
MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion and marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.

03:26 Hug
MeMo and BaBa discover that sometimes all you need is a hug to make things better.

05:00 Lost
MeMo comforts BaBa when they lose their precious forever flower.

05:59 Jumpy Planet
BaBa wants to jump like MeMo. Together they find a fun way to help BaBa bounce.

07:43 Noise
BaBa loves playing with a noisy drum but discovers that not everyone likes loud noises.

08:59 Circles
MeMo and BaBa discover different types of circles all over Planet BeddyByes.

09:52 Surprise
MeMo and BaBa unwrap a surprise parcel as they travel across Planet BeddyByes.

10:51 Sticky Leaf
MeMo and BaBa can’t get rid of a sticky leaf but then find surprising ways to play with it.

11:53 Floating
MeMo and BaBa enjoy seeing and playing with floaty things.

13:02 Flute
BaBa wants to play the flute as well as MeMo.

13:57 Sorry
BaBa learns that when you say sorry, you need to truly mean it.

15:04 Mystery Song
MeMo and BaBa go on the hunt for an intriguing sound.

16:05 Wheels
MeMo and BaBa have fun discovering wheels and the joy of motion.

17:10 Hiccup
BaBa has the hiccups. MeMo helps them disappear before BeddyByes time.

17:59 Wind
MeMo and BaBa discover many new ways to play on a windy day.

18:59 Stars
BaBa wants to see a shooting star, but must learn to be patient.

20:00 Where's Yummy
MeMo and BaBa discover their Yummies game is in fact a Yummy Dog hunt.

21:03 Red And Yellow Together
MeMo and BaBa learn about two very special colors.

21:58 Gentle
BaBa learns how to be gentle with animals and delicate objects.

22:59 Looky Tube
MeMo and BaBa play with a cardboard tube.

24:06 Bigger
MeMo and BaBa learn how some things are bigger and others are smaller.

25:07 MeMo's Bag
MeMo’s bag is very useful. BaBa and MeMo use it to carry things around.

26:06 Friend Song
MeMo, BaBa, and their friends listen to the sounds all around them.

27:06 Squish Up
MeMo and BaBa need to find the right home for their squishy ball.

28:08 Rainbows
MeMo and BaBa follow rainbows all over Planet BeddyByes.

Available on Disney Jr. and Disney+ 
https://www.disneyplus.com/whats-on
